notes: Site: Shopify storefront myborosil.com (www redirects to non-www canonical). Tier-1 direct HTTP fetch worked throughout; no block encountered; no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. Checked: collections.json (393 published collections across 2 pages), homepage header mega-menu, homepage shop-by-category chip carousel (126 links, no new-arrivals-worded entry present), footer (no collection links), and /search/suggest.json for queries 'new arrivals', 'new', 'latest' etc. VALID NEW-ARRIVALS-TYPE LISTINGS FOUND: (1) /collections/new-arrival 'New Arrival' and (2) /collections/larah-new-arrivals 'Larah New Arrivals' (Larah by Borosil sub-brand on the same storefront) -- neither is linked from the homepage/header nav, both surfaced only via the site's own predictive search, then opened and confirmed as real product listings (titles, filters, pagination), satisfying the brief's 'search is supporting evidence, must still be opened and validated' rule. EXCLUDED after inspection (fail criterion 2 -- not a genuine 'recently added to the catalogue' listing): 'Kulhad new launch' (/collections/kulhad-new-launch, 15 products) -- a narrow single-product-family launch (Larah Kulhad/Curl Cup/Octa Mug shapes only), not a sitewide new-arrivals concept. 'New GripGo' (/collections/new-gripgo, 24 products) -- a specific named product line ('GripGo'), not a recency concept. 'New Handcrafted Borosilicate Range' (/collections/handmade-borosilicate-range, 20 products) -- a specific named product range, not a recency concept. 'newmrp' (/collections/newmrp, 624 products) -- the 'new' here reads as 'new MRP' (a price-list/pricing-admin grouping per its raw internal-looking handle and title), not a customer-facing new-arrivals merchandising page. No Clearance-adjacent overlap issues here. CROSS-CHECK FINDING (kept, not a reason to drop the rows): products.json dedup-by-id shows 'New Arrival' (2257 of the site's ~3061 total products, ~74%) is a strict subset of the 'Trending' collection recorded in bs235.json, and is itself a superset of 'Best Sellers' (2248) -- i.e. Bestsellers subset-of New-Arrivals subset-of Trending on the main brand. On the Larah sub-brand, 'Larah New Arrivals' and 'Larah Bestseller' (bs235.json) are BYTE-IDENTICAL product sets (1122/1122 full intersection) -- literally the same listing exposed under two different merchandising labels. This nesting/identity pattern is circumstantial evidence these may be broad automated collections rather than a hand-curated 'what's new' selection, even though each individually passes the open-and-confirm PLP test (real listing, correctly titled, reachable via site search, distinct/exact product count) -- flagged per-row below for reviewer judgement.
